name: LakeStream
description: Scraping, enrichment and ATS job-board ingestion. Turns the front of the funnel into DAG nodes — previously reachable only by running the e2e bridge scripts by hand.

actions.label: Fetch Job Postings (Batch)
actions.description: Live Greenhouse / Lever / Ashby postings for many companies at once (max 50). A new posting is a hiring signal, and signal-triggered outreach is the largest single lever on reply rate in the 2026 benchmarks — several times larger than anything infrastructure spend buys. Pair with champmail.enroll_sequence to act on it.

actions.label: Fetch Job Postings (One Company)
actions.description: Postings for a single company, with a hiring summary. Board-token discovery is deliberately conservative: guessing is disabled because a loose guess matched a DIFFERENT company's board. A company whose careers page is JS-rendered returns nothing rather than someone else's roles.

actions.label: Extract Page (Schema-Guided)
actions.description: Structured extraction from one URL. Escalates PLAYWRIGHT → PLAYWRIGHT_PROXY on a block or captcha and returns tier_used and cost_usd, so a DAG can see what a page actually cost instead of assuming the cheapest tier.

tier.description: Omit to let it escalate automatically

actions.label: Scrape Site
actions.description: Queue a crawl for a domain. Returns a job id; poll with domain_stats or pull results with export_csv / export_json.

actions.label: Discover Companies
actions.description: Search for companies matching a query. Entry point for building a target list without a CSV.

actions.label: Discovery Status
actions.description: Progress and results for a discovery run.

actions.label: Export Results (CSV)
actions.description: Scraped records for a job as CSV — the handoff into champmail.bulk_import_prospects or Harbinger import.

actions.label: Export Results (JSON)
actions.description: Scraped records for a job as JSON.

actions.label: Track Domain
actions.description: Watch a domain for changes so re-scrapes are incremental rather than full.

actions.label: List Tracked Domains
actions.description: Domains currently being watched for changes.

actions.label: Domain Stats
actions.description: Pages scraped, records extracted and last-run time for one domain.

actions.label: Proxy Health
actions.description: Residential proxy pool status. Worth checking before a large PLAYWRIGHT_PROXY run, since that tier is roughly 4x the cost of the default.
